issues.detail: Rule forces start_shifting=0 before detection, but quote only states setting to 1 on detection; uncertain=false.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.

issues.detail: Quote establishes active-high synchronous reset only; rule also forces state S0 and start_shifting=0 without verbatim evidence, uncertain=false.
S1-S110/FOUND meanings transition to S0 when reset=1, but update_during_reset=false; S0 is true while reset=1 still stays S0.
R_SET_OR_HOLD and R_KEEP examples have no reset=1 row yet assume initial S0; reset initialization is only defined after reset.
Spec does not specify same-edge versus one-cycle-later assertion of start_shifting; contract chooses same_cycle.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: start_shifting is registered one clock after detection: it remains 0 on the row completing 1101 and becomes 1 on the following row.
